messages:
anya (product): Heads-up: BankWave asked for a contract that allows scheduled burst leases that can be turned on/off by date range and reconciled to a monthly burst line. They also want clear rules for per-route circuit-breakers. Need to scope engineering and billing work for next sprint.

devin (eng-runtime): Quick Q: do we treat these as separate reserved pools or as metadata on an existing pool (calendar + route tags)? Prefer metadata so we don't proliferate pools.

anya (product): Prefer metadata too. BankWave wants a named lease that maps to routes and a calendar. Lease must guarantee X tokens/min for listed windows.

nina (billing): For invoicing we'll need per-lease usage export (lease_id, route, tokens_used, window_start). Also reconciliation job to map observed tokens to billed tokens; we should include a 48hr dispute window.

priya (eng-sre): Operational concerns: preemption semantics need to be deterministic. If lease is active, high-priority routes get scheduled first. If overcommit happens, define spill rules: (a) queue with short TTL, (b) degrade to quantized model variant, or (c) reject with explicit 429 + descriptive error. Which do we prefer?

devin (eng-runtime): Implementation-wise we can support all three as configurable per-lease. Default behavior: queue (50ms), then fallback to quantized model, then reject. That keeps latency bounded.

carl (legal): Contract note: include audit logging clause and exportability for sampled requests. Customers in finance will require retention of lease activity logs for 6 months. Also add SLA credits formula for missed guaranteed burst minutes.

anya (product): Good point. Add audit log export to scope. Also BankWave asked for a clause that lets them schedule "no-preempt" days during testing. We need to decide whether that blocks our backup capacity.

priya (eng-sre): "no-preempt" days mean we cannot evict lower tiers. That increases risk for other tenants. We can allow it but gate to paid higher-tier only. Ops needs a capacity commitment.

nina (billing): If we expose no-preempt days, we should bill a premium for those days as an availability surcharge. I'll draft numbers.

devin (eng-runtime): Prototype config for lease metadata I sketched for dev sandbox:
```
lease:
  id: BW-2025-07-lease1
  routes: ["/v1/settle", "/v1/pay"]
  calendar:
    - start: 2025-07-20T02:00:00Z
      end: 2025-07-20T06:00:00Z
  guaranteed_tokens_per_min: 120000
  preemption_policy: 
    no_preempt_days: ["2025-07-25", "2025-08-01"]
    fallback_sequence: ["queue:50ms","quantized-model","reject"]
  billing_export: true
```

priya (eng-sre): Monitoring checklist for pilot:
- per-lease token rate by route (1m)
- routing latency p50/p95 by lease and route
- fallback and reject counts per lease
- preemption events timeline (who got evicted when)

anya (product): Pilot gating criteria: billing export works end-to-end, audit log export in S3 for a lease, preemption toggle + rollback, and contract language signed for audit retention and no-preempt surcharge.

carl (legal): I'll prep template language for the lease appendix and SLA credit formula. One ask: make the audit logs available in both CSV and parquet.

nina (billing): Will create a billing export schema. Also need a reconciliation job in beta that marks 'billed' vs 'observed' with reasons for mismatch.

devin (eng-runtime): Estimate: plumbing lease metadata through router + scheduler: 6 dev days. Model-fallback plumbing: 3 days. Billing export + schema + reconciliation: 4 days (with nina). Dashboards + alerts: 2 days. Total ~15 dev-days including testing. Can parallelize.

priya (eng-sre): Ops tasks: add kill-switch for lease enforcement, test chaos scenarios to ensure no silent degradation, and run a dry-run simulation against production-like traffic. 3 oncall days to support pilot.

ops-bot: scheduled dry-run simulation in prod-sim on 2025-07-22T00:00:00Z. :white_check_mark:

anya (product): Action items: (1) devin + priya: prototype lease metadata in sandbox this week, (2) nina + devin: billing export schema and reconciliation job spec, (3) carl: lease appendix draft, (4) product to prep pilot doc and customer stub contract. Decision deadline: Wed EOD.

devin (eng-runtime): Ack. Will start sandbox prototype and post logs in the epic.

nina (billing): I'll share schema draft by EOD today.

priya (eng-sre): I'll schedule the chaos run and get ops signoff.

anya (product): thanks team — let's aim to keep the pilot minimal: one lease, two routes, one month retention for logs in pilot. We'll revisit longer retention and multi-lease support in the roadmap. :rocket:
